messages:
Eli (AE): Heads-up: Vega Systems POC — 14 days. Start with Hosted API keys in EU; mid-POC they may ask for Dedicated and VPC peering. They want a clear internal onboarding checklist and a short pricing note for procurement. Who can own the flow?
Nina (SE): I can own onboarding. Need expected qps, model family preference, and whether embeddings will be used for search. Also will prepare the procurement FAQ.
Eli (AE): They expect ~70 rps peak, mostly chat; embeddings for semantic search in week 2. Prefer open models. EU-only data residency.
Kai (Platform Eng): Hosted path: trial org + ephemeral key + org cap. Dedicated sizing: 1x8 GPU baseline with autoscale; VPC peering needs infra intake, lead time ~8-12bd. For peering we need their test subnet and peering CIDR.
Rosa (Security): Noted: SOC2 required, customer-managed KMS preferred, EU tenancy, and short retention (30d). I'll prepare the security questionnaire responses and a BYO-KMS checklist.
Nina (SE): Concise internal runbook:
- Step 1: Create trial org vega-poc in eu-west-1 and generate ephemeral API key
- Step 2: Apply rate limits (70 rps) and billing cap $1,500; enable usage alerts
- Step 3: Share quickstart repo + example curl and SDK snippets
- Step 4: Collect ops and security contacts, confirm data types and NDA scope
- Step 5: If Dedicated requested, open POC-Ded ticket and schedule a sizing call with Kai
- Step 6: If VPC peering requested, request peering CIDR and open infra intake (expect 8-12bd)
Kai (Platform Eng): Internal CLI examples:
```
rwctl org create --name "vega-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org vega-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
rwctl dedicated create --org vega-poc --gpus 8 --region eu-west-1 --private --note "poc-demo"
```
Rosa (Security): BYO-KMS checklist to include: KMS vendor and version, key ID and policy, attestation docs, rotation policy, and whether they want our KMIP proxy. I'll turn around the questionnaire in 48h.
infra-bot: ticket POC-VPC-212 created by Kai for Vega Systems.
Nina (SE): I'll provision the hosted key and run a quick smoke test (eu-west-1) then send the runbook + pricing note to Eli.
Eli (AE): Thanks team. Owners: Nina = onboarding + runbook, Rosa = security responses + KMS checklist, Kai = infra path. I'll schedule kickoff with Vega Systems tomorrow 09:30 CET. :calendar:
